|lore=Planetary scale shield projected from surface of Endor moon. Protected second Death Star during construction. Only another superlaser could penetrate it while operational.
|game_text=Deploy on table. Unless Rebel Strike Team on table, opponent generates no Force at Endor system. Twice per game, may take an admiral, commander, general, or moff into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Whenever opponent’s Endor on table, raise your converted Endor system to the top (if possible). (Immune to Alter.)
|printings={{Card versions/Endor Shield}}
|notes=The original Set 11 issuer sheet survives alongside the 2006 remaster. Both sheets suppress opposing Force generation at Endor, permit the same twice-per-game hand search and raise your Endor card to the top when possible. The later slip specifies a converted Endor, the normal condition for your Endor to need raising while the opponent’s card is on top. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=2 Players Committee original sheet, p. 2, slip 19]. [[:File:VS11O-19-Endor_Shield.png|Publisher slip]].
